completed.title: The plan document contract
completed.summary: Plans had grown into documents answering four questions at once, with no rule for what belonged where or when evidence was written down. They now follow a contract: a plan gains one section as it advances, and automated checks refuse to publish work that skipped one.

completed.title: Trained dictionary compression for raw HTML
completed.summary: Cut stored detail-page HTML to about 5% of its original size while preserving lossless, independently readable artifacts and compatibility with older captures.

completed.title: The testing contract
completed.summary: The rules for how this project tests itself used to be a paragraph of documentation that slowly went out of date. They are now a contract the suite checks on every change, so the description cannot quietly stop matching the code.

completed.title: Test suite maintenance
completed.summary: Made test coverage visible on every change instead of measured and thrown away, and fixed a test database that did not match the shape of the real one.
